bias_targets.methodology: Quantifying typological diversity in NLP datasets using Mean Pairwise Syntactic Distance (MPSD) via lang2vec and Feature Value Inclusion (FVI) via Grambank, and comparing multilingual model performance on the XTREME-R benchmark across different typological features (e.g., prefixing vs. suffixing, word order).

Mapping the geographic origin of languages used in NLP evaluation datasets to demonstrate spatial skews, such as the over-representation of European languages and the under-representation of languages from the Americas.
